drills.q: Why is brand voice conditioning insufficient protection against hallucinated facts?
drills.a: Tone and factual accuracy are orthogonal properties of generated text controlled by different mechanisms -- a model can be perfectly on-brand while stating a completely fabricated fact.

drills.q: What claim types should never be openly LLM-generated in production marketing copy?
drills.a: Price, availability, policy terms, and health/safety statements -- anything a customer could reasonably rely on and later hold the company to. These need retrieval-grounding or template-filling from verified data, not free generation.

drills.q: Summarize the Air Canada chatbot case and its architectural implication.
drills.a: The airline's chatbot fabricated a bereavement-fare policy; a tribunal held Air Canada contractually bound, rejecting the defense that the chatbot was a separate entity. Implication: claims customers could rely on must be grounded in verified retrieved data, not left to open generation with a disclaimer.

drills.q: Compare few-shot/prompt-based brand voice conditioning to fine-tuning.
drills.a: Few-shot: cheap, fast to iterate, weaker under distribution shift/unusual inputs. Fine-tuning (typically LoRA/QLoRA): more robust and consistent at scale, slower/costlier to update, risks baking in any errors in the curated training corpus.

drills.q: What does a production content quality gate score and what should it do with the scores?
drills.a: Brand-voice adherence, factual-risk flags (price/date/superlative/health/financial claims), compliance flags, fluency -- via a lightweight fast classifier, not another LLM call. It should TRIAGE by risk: auto-publish/spot-check for low-risk, mandatory human review for flagged or uncertain content.

drills.q: What is the rubber-stamping failure mode in human-in-the-loop review and how do you detect it?
drills.a: When review volume outpaces capacity or the gate mostly produces false positives, reviewers stop genuinely scrutinizing content and approve by default. Detect by sampling approved content for independent secondary review -- a near-zero disagreement rate with high throughput signals rubber-stamping.

drills.q: Why does a quality gate calibrated on English content fail on other locales?
drills.a: Hallucination rates and voice-adherence baselines differ by language -- lower-resource languages typically have higher error rates due to less training representation, and tone/formality norms differ by culture. An English-tuned threshold is usually too permissive elsewhere and needs per-locale recalibration.

drills.q: Why is a source-fact-to-claim audit trail treated as a compliance requirement, not just engineering hygiene?
drills.a: Given FTC enforcement priorities on deceptive AI marketing claims, EU AI Act labeling requirements, and legal precedent (Air Canada) holding companies liable for AI-generated statements, being able to show which verified source grounded a specific published claim is the difference between a defensible and indefensible position if challenged.

drills.q: A stakeholder wants to remove human review entirely for a high-volume content category to cut costs. How do you evaluate the request?
drills.a: Assess the content category's risk tier: genuinely low-stakes, highly templated content with a strong quality-gate track record can move to spot-check or auto-publish. Anything touching price, availability, legal claims, or flagship messaging should stay behind mandatory review regardless of gate performance, because the cost asymmetry of one bad instance vastly outweighs throughput savings.

drills.q: Design the content-generation architecture for a travel company shipping property descriptions across 22 locales where amenities and pricing must never be fabricated.
drills.a: Verified structured property data feeds a RAG-constrained generation step (ideally template-filling factual fields directly, LLM-generating only surrounding prose). Brand voice via locale-specific fine-tuning/few-shot, calibrated per locale, not inherited from English. A per-locale-calibrated quality gate routes by risk, with mandatory human review for price/availability/policy language regardless of locale. Full audit trail logs source-to-claim mapping for every published description.
